multidayTours.title: Classic Sri Lanka
multidayTours.description: Sri Lanka is a beautiful country. You will visit beaches, mountains and tea plantations...
whyLove: Travel with an expert local guide who knows the hidden gems.
Enjoy authentic local cuisine and cultural encounters.
Flexible booking with free cancellation options.

rightForYou: You'll need to carry your bags on and off local trams and trains. The distances aren't far, but be aware of cobblestone streets.
This trip uses a combination of public and private transport. All vehicles are modern and have air-conditioning.
This is a relatively fast-paced trip that will allow you to see the highlights in a short period.
visas: Most nationalities require a visa to enter Sri Lanka. Please check with your local embassy.
accommodation: Hotels are carefully selected to provide a comfortable stay. Wi-Fi is available in most locations.
joiningPoint: The trip starts at our base hotel in Colombo at 6:00 PM on Day 1.
